The climate in Kiruna

Kiruna is about 550 m above sea level. The warmest month is July, with an average high of 17°C; the coldest is January, when nights average −15°C. Around 700 mm of precipitation falls in a year on average, most of it in July (about 103 mm). The highest temperature in Kiruna in 2015–2024 was 31°C (4 July 2021) and the lowest −37°C (3 January 2024).

Best time to visit Kiruna

The most pleasant weather in Kiruna is usually in June, July and August: average highs are between 14°C and 17°C, with up to 15 days of rain a month. In January, February, March, April, October, November and December nights are frosty (below −3°C on average) and snow is common.
